claim: Every procurement_conversations query in apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/procurement.service.ts that names order_id also filters restaurant_id (24 such queries), so the deal and vendor-reply paths answer only for the caller's house (ADR 0147; ADR 0171 option 3: the gateway reads with the service role, so RLS fences nothing; v3.0-TECH-DEBT 'The deal and reply paths read and wrote another house's vendor messages on the same order id'). On origin/main at 46c3fdb5d, 10 of them carried no house filter: getDealProposal (the deal modal), resolveLatestDealProposal's read (dismissDeal, confirmDeal), confirmDeal's and manualReply's thread read (the subject, Message-ID, References and Gmail thread of the letter to the vendor) and their DISCARDED sweeps, generateAiReply's inbound read (the message, thread and vendor handed to the responder), and the newerReplyStillAnalyzing and newerInboundSince guards (approve, confirm, scheduled auto-send). procurement_conversations.order_id is a plain FK to procurement_orders(id) with nothing tying a row's house to its order's. Now resolveLatestDealProposal, newerReplyStillAnalyzing and newerInboundSince take the house first, every caller passes it (approveDraft and confirmDeal pass restaurantId, the auto-send sweep passes row.restaurant_id), and the resolve's update by id also filters restaurant_id. Carried from preserved snapshot a34b28aee (hunks 3-7) and widened to the whole file. Static: the verify strips comments, counts at least 20 order-keyed chains, and pins the four spec case names. Measured: fails on 46c3fdb5d (and with main's service under the branch's spec), and each of 7 static mutants (the resolve update filter dropped, the resolve read filter line-commented, the modal filter block-commented, dismissDeal, the sweep, the confirm gate or the approve gate passing something other than the house) fails it; dropping any one of the file's 25 conversation house filters it pins fails it; a missing file is a Traceback (cannot-run). Spec vendor-doors-are-sealed.spec.ts: 10 cases red on 46c3fdb5d, 37/37 after; 9 of the 10 added filters are killed by the spec alone, and the tenth (the resolve's update by id, defence in depth behind its house-scoped read) only by this claim.

claim: A house letter's orderId is checked against the caller's house before the letter is stored (v3.0-TECH-DEBT 'A house letter stores the order id its request names without checking the order is this house's'; ADR 0147). OPEN: on 46c3fdb5d QueueLetterDto.orderId is only @IsOptional() @IsUUID() (house-letters.dto.ts), HouseLettersService.checkLetter (shared by ask and queue) checks the vendor and the address against the house's book and never reads the order, and queue inserts order_id: dto.orderId ?? draft?.orderId ?? null beside restaurant_id: restaurantId, so a session for one house can file a procurement_conversations row on another house's order. The claim holds, and fails the build until this row is struck, once checkLetter reads procurement_orders by dto.orderId AND restaurant_id or calls an assert*Order* helper on dto.orderId. It stays open for an id-only read and for a commented-out check; a renamed checkLetter prints 'cannot open method checkLetter' and a missing file is a Traceback, both cannot-run. Static; the five shapes were each measured.
